answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded juniper that changes every epoch. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra terrace buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The anchor is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 11crs.
